2707-3617-6005.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Malevolent Chandelier by paying {2}, causing you to put Time Walk on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

529-4927-5641-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2445-3899-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
2445-3899-5254.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat.

654-851-2557-3129-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1018-1987-3110.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1018-1987-3110.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1018-1987-3110.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1987-2427-7487.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
1987-2427-7487.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Zealous Lorecaster.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2427-7487.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

957-7334-7722.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Neutrinos.
957-7334-7722.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one
Move to your first extra turn
Blink Thor using The Neutrinos.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Stretch from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your second extra turn.
Cast Time Stretch from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

803-4302-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
803-4302-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Arcane Adaptation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2178-2921-7185-7284.description:
Cast Belonging by paying {5}{W}.
When Belonging enters, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Shapeshifter creature tokens with changeling.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Belonging.
When Belonging dies, Rat King triggers, untapping Rat King.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Rat King by tapping it and sacrificing the Shapeshifters.
When the Shapeshifters die, Rat King triggers three times, untapping Rat King.
Resolve the Rat King ability from step 5, returning Belonging from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

527-1409-7297.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Selvala by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Selvala enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Selvala.
Repeat.

3372-4050-4460-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
3372-4050-4460-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {1}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

628-2438-7198.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Flitterwing Nuisance.
When Flitterwing Nuisance dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1726-2511-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Scrapyard Recombiner.
When Scrapyard Recombiner dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Scrapyard Recombiner's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Scrapyard Recombiner from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

339-677-6798-6968.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1978-3007-5527.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1978-3007-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
1978-3007-5527.description:
Animate Five Hundred Year Diary using Toymaker.
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding {U} for each Clue you control
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2854-4211-4574-5243.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2854-4211-4574-5243.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1088-2060-6701-6798.description:
Activate Persistent Specimen by paying {2}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Persistent Specimen.
When Persistent Specimen is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{B}.
Repeat.
1088-2060-6701-6798.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

880-4862-6664.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-4862-6664.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the land enters the battlefield, Omnath triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

856-2279-4050-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

397-5070-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
397-5070-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing the Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
When the Citizen enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2060-2178-3143-3490.notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least one other creature.
Thornbite Staff attached to Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
2060-2178-3143-3490.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Xavier Sal triggers, untapping Xavier Sal.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
If you control another creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, you will get infinite +1/+1 counters among creatures you control, and you may instead use Xavier Sal's first ability to get infinite copies of creature tokens you control.

1339-5231-5572.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-5231-5572.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Dragon Appeasement triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

230-2557-3002-4050.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a card in exile.
230-2557-3002-4050.description:
Activate Void Attendant by paying {1}{G} and putting a card an opponent owns from exile into their graveyard.
The card is instead put back into exile due to Rest in Peace.
Resolve the Void Attendant ability, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Eldrazi Scions, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1170-3075-4182.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least five experience counters.
You control a nonland permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
1170-3075-4182.description:
Activate the nonland permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Whispers of the Muse with buyback by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking the nonland permanent.
Resolve Whispers of the Muse, causing you to draw a card and return it to your hand.
Repeat.

229-1012-5220.description:
Cast Endless One either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Endless One enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Endless One on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1584-2020-2430-2670.description:
Activate Teferi's Isle by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Petals of Insight by paying {U}, and choosing to pay an additional {U} and reveal Psychic Puppetry from your hand, adding Psychic Puppetry's effects to Petals of Insight.
Resolve Petals of Insight, looking at the top three cards of your library, putting them on the bottom of your library, untapping Teferi's Isle, and returning Petals of Insight to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2947-4881.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Vesperlark, adding {C}{C}.
When Vesperlark dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Vesperlark.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Activated Sleeper, adding {C}{C}.
When Activated Sleeper dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Vesperlark.
Repeat from step 3.

722-3153-4615.description:
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying {1}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Sphinx of the Second Sun.
Cast Chronomantic Escape by paying {4}{W}{W}, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and exiling Chronomantic Escape with three time counters on it.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, Sphinx of the Second Sun and the Sphinx of the Second Sun token each trigger, causing you to get two additional beginning phases after this phase.
Move to your first additional beginning phase.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself and causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chronomantic Escape,  causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and exiling Chronomantic Escape with three time counters on it.
Repeat from step 3.

3259-4068-5251.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control a Mountain.
3259-4068-5251.description:
Declare Emmara and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token with lifelink.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Soldier token, untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-3817-5170.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
2034-3817-5170.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junji, adding {C}{C}.
When Junji dies, it triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield, and causing you to gain 5 life.
Resolve the Ashnod's Altar ability from step 2.
Repeat.

1263-2034-2060-3602.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {C}{C}.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Bhaal triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler and goading it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

240-2689-4486.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to increase only Atla Palani's toughness by at least one.
240-2689-4486.description:
Increase Atla's toughness by at least one.
Activate Mirror Entity an arbitrarily large number of times by paying a total of {0}.
Resolve the first Mirror Entity ability, causing all creatures you control to have base power and toughness 0/0 and gain all creature types until end of turn.
All creatures you control except Atla die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
If Hostility died this way, it triggers, shuffling itself into your library.
Atla triggers once for each creature that died.
Resolve the first Atla trigger, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card, then putting the creature card onto the battlefield and all other revealed cards on the bottom of your library.
Repeat step 7 for each remaining Atla trigger.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining Mirror Entity ability.
